prompts.video:
Create a polished, restrained software architecture diagram, landscape, high resolution, intended for an engineer's real design document. Flat vector drafting appearance on white (#FFFFFF), charcoal type, thin precise gray orthogonal connectors, small muted blue accents (#DCEAF3). Generous whitespace, consistent grid and box sizing, sharp legible Korean sans-serif typography like Pretendard. Absolutely no gradients, shadows, glows, 3D, mascots, brains, robots, sparkles, stock illustrations, decorative icons, invented logos or marketing copy. Boxes and connector endpoints must be unambiguous; no intersecting labels. Use only the specified visible text. Human-made technical documentation aesthetic. All text must be spelled exactly; favor large readable labels over cramming. This is an architecture drawing, not a poster.
Title at top left, exact Korean: "요청 기반 AI 서비스"
Small subtitle: "영상 아키텍처"
Create the principal request flow across the upper middle from left to right using five boxes:
1 "Slack" subtitle "요청 · 응답"
2 "n8n" subtitle "이벤트 연동"
3 "FastAPI" subtitle "접수 · 검증"
4 "작업 큐" subtitle "대기 · 분배"
5 a wider box "AI Worker" subtitle "LangGraph 흐름 제어"
Arrows only 1→2→3→4→5, pointing right, a small label "작업 접수" over the 3→4 edge.
Below the AI Worker place two clearly separate modules next to each other, each connected bidirectionally to the Worker:
"문서 검색" with subtitle "임베딩 · Vector DB"
"LLM" with subtitle "분석 · 답변 생성"
These modules are tools used by the worker, not upstream request queues.
A separate bottom horizontal response path runs RIGHT TO LEFT: from AI Worker down to "결과 저장", then left to "n8n", then left to "Slack". Arrowheads must make worker→결과저장→n8n→Slack obvious. These repeat the same n8n and Slack as the upper entry path to keep the return path readable. Label the lower route "처리 결과 회신".
At bottom small plain legend: "접수 응답과 작업 완료는 별도 상태"
Do not add actor, services, databases, frameworks, or flows beyond these. Do not imply multiple agents or two LLMs.
prompts.project:
Create a polished, restrained software architecture diagram, landscape, high resolution, intended for an engineer's real design document. Flat vector drafting appearance on white (#FFFFFF), charcoal type, thin precise gray orthogonal connectors, small muted blue accents (#DCEAF3). Generous whitespace, consistent grid and box sizing, sharp legible Korean sans-serif typography like Pretendard. Absolutely no gradients, shadows, glows, 3D, mascots, brains, robots, sparkles, stock illustrations, decorative icons, invented logos or marketing copy. Boxes and connector endpoints must be unambiguous; no intersecting labels. Use only the specified visible text. Human-made technical documentation aesthetic. All text must be spelled exactly; favor large readable labels over cramming. This is an architecture drawing, not a poster.
Title at top left, exact Korean: "AI 운영 시스템"
Small subtitle: "우리 프로젝트의 구현 구조"
Use three horizontal lanes with unobtrusive left-aligned lane headings. Lane1 at top "01  접수와 조사". Lane2 middle "02  선택적 모델 분석". Lane3 bottom "03  승인 후 복구".
Lane1 left-to-right boxes: "경보 · CI · 운영자" → "검증 · 전달" → "SQLite 영속 큐" → "읽기 Worker" → "증거 · 규칙 보고서".
Below the worker within lane1 a small text line, not a service box: "Kubernetes · Argo · Prometheus". Draw a short read connector to the worker. Below the queue small plain annotation "중복 방지 · lease · 재시작 복구".
Lane2: a dashed arrow originates from "증거 · 규칙 보고서" in lane1 and reaches "정제 view · outbox", then right arrows through "승인 · 예산 Gateway" → "LLM" → "별도 모델 보고서". Subtitle in final box "needs_review". The dashed entry means optional, with label "승인된 격리 입력만".
Lane3: a separate path ALSO originates from lane1 report, NOT from the LLM nor its report. Then five boxes left-to-right: "인증된 해결 요청" → "복구 PR 작성 App" → "사람 리뷰 · 필수 CI" → "병합 · Argo 동기화" → "회복 검증". In the review box small text "정확한 head", in the merge box small text "별도 병합 App", in recovery verification small text "HTTP · 지표 · 경보".
Surround lane3 with a very subtle plain outline labeled "격리 실습 대상". This lane is conditional on verified evidence and actual human review, not autonomous LLM control.
Under lane3, one slim safeguard box "실패 · 취소 · 기한 도달 → 소유 · 독립 원복 감시", with short dashed connectors from the execution/verification area.
Small bottom note: "모델 출력은 실행 권한이 아니다"
Very small bottom note: "구조 설명도 · 실환경 검증 상태는 별도 관리"
Critical constraints: NO arrow from LLM or model report to recovery execution or approval. Main investigation worker does not get write privileges. Distinguish optional model analysis from deterministic recovery control. Keep plenty of room, avoid crossing routing by using dedicated vertical gutters at lane edges.
